exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, original Daoist chibi hand-painted game inventory icons. Create six DISTINCT fruit-shaped crystal sugar-bubble skins on a true transparent RGBA atlas, requested1536x1024, regular THREE columns by TWO rows of512px square cells, six complete isolated objects in row-major order.
Image1 is the source STRUCTURE/SEMANTIC reference board only. Use the item identity, broad fruit silhouette and key color/material differences of each cell, NOT its pixel rendering, board, labels or the detached grey drop shadows. Images2 and3 are the user-selected original Daoist Q hand-painted visual style: delicate jade leaves, warm ivory-gold accents, gentle painterly light, rounded lovable forms and fine crafted detail. Do not paint UI, characters, scenery, plates or text.
This is a new ORIGINAL fruit-and-dessert production family, inventory artwork only, not a world animation. Draw each fruit as a charming magical sugar-crystal fruit in refined 2D game illustration: soft rounded dimensional form, translucent glaze where appropriate, hand-painted edge and subtle cloud-shaped internal light. Tasteful thin warm-gold veins on a small jade leaf or stem can link the family; no enclosing metal medallion rim, no ornamental frame. Colorful appetizing fruit identity is dominant, mobile readable, high detail. No faces, eyes, hands, bodies or added pets. Not photoreal photography, plastic3D, flat emoji or simple vectors.
Cell1 TOP LEFT: item256, ROUND strawberry crystal bubble. Distinct from cell5: almost spherical bright vermilion-red fruit, a small cluster of green jade leaves and short stem at upper-left, sparse golden seed dimples, a subtle amber lower-edge glow INSIDE fruit. Round bulb silhouette, not a long teardrop.
Cell2 TOP MIDDLE: item257, whole WATERMELON bubble, round emerald-green sphere, broad deep green curved rind stripes, short curled green stem and tiny jade leaf at upper-left. No cut watermelon slice or red flesh.
Cell3 TOP RIGHT: item1969, CRYSTAL APPLE, pale icy cyan-blue translucent glass apple with two rounded top lobes, a shallow top notch, one curved crystal stem and faint subtle apple core glow. Clearly BLUE CRYSTAL, not a red edible apple. No extra orbiting ice shards.
Cell4 BOTTOM LEFT: item2092, CANTALOUPE, round yellow-green melon with fine pale-gold netted rind, short brown branching T-shaped stem on top and small jade leaf. Netted green melon, not watermelon stripes.
Cell5 BOTTOM MIDDLE: item2203, RIPE STRAWBERRY, visibly pointed red strawberry teardrop tilted slightly right, dense small warm-gold seeds and a leafy deep jade crown with a short stem. Distinct angular lower point and leaf cap compared with ROUND strawberry cell1.
Cell6 BOTTOM RIGHT: item2416, IMMORTAL PEACH, one plump pointed-top longevity peach, warm cream-gold to blush-pink gradient skin, soft central peach cleft and two fresh jade-green leaves attached just below the fruit. Leaves are part of the peach, not a separate ground base. No lettering.
All six same gentle front three-quarter game-icon view and lighting. Each complete object about330–385px high/wide, centered within its512px cell with at least55px genuinely clear transparent margins; preserve the full stem/leaves. Nothing touches or crosses a grid line.
No UI border, blue selection box, number, label, Chinese word, text, platform, pedestal, ground, floor, detached oval shadow, cast shadow, glow outside silhouette, sparkles, fog or backdrop. Empty space is true alpha0. Clean antialiasing only around the actual fruit shapes. Highest host-provided painted detail.
